components.name: Directory action
components.description: Connect, Finish setup, Open, and Retry use the same compact bordered action.
components.css: .ds-action { min-height:36px; padding:6px 14px; border:1px solid var(--misty-theme-border, #393939); border-radius:6px; background:var(--misty-theme-card, #191919); color:var(--misty-theme-text, #e0e0e0); font:13px system-ui; cursor:pointer; } .ds-action:hover { background:var(--misty-theme-hover, #2b2b2b); } .ds-action:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--misty-theme-text-muted, #8c8c8c); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-action:disabled { opacity:0.5; cursor:default; }

components.name: Shortcut visibility action
components.description: Hide or show an added account in the sidebar without removing its session.
components.css: .ds-action { min-height:36px; padding:6px 14px; border:1px solid var(--misty-theme-border, #393939); border-radius:6px; background:var(--misty-theme-card, #191919); color:var(--misty-theme-text, #e0e0e0); font:13px system-ui; cursor:pointer; } .ds-action:hover { background:var(--misty-theme-hover, #2b2b2b); } .ds-action:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--misty-theme-text-muted, #8c8c8c); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-action:disabled { opacity:0.5; cursor:default; } .ds-action.ds-secondary { border-color:transparent; background:transparent; } .ds-action.ds-secondary:hover { background:var(--misty-theme-hover, #2b2b2b); }

narrative.overview: Scoped to the Social and Inbox provider directory. Inherits Misty’s compact dark desktop UI, continuous lists, restrained separators, and existing theme-tinted brand assets.
dos: Do preserve native Misty messaging and existing provider assets.
Do distinguish setup, added accounts, and hidden shortcuts.
donts: Don’t introduce card grids, gradients, or ambient glows.
Don’t imply website sign-in provides mail search authorization.
